capabilities: Browse a local Grimorio image library as a document
Search filenames, tags, annotations and related-note links
Filter tags and browse paginated thumbnails
Edit annotations with draft recovery and conflict detection
Link existing notes and copy references
disambiguation: Not a Pinterest importer; it browses an existing Grimorio library and leaves image imports to Grimorio.
extras: Discontinued and replaced by Grimarium; manual install only, Windows desktop only, mobile unsupported, and annotation editing needs a companion patch to Grimorio.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse a Grimorio image library and its annotations without creating a Markdown note for every image.

relations.evidence: Browse a local Grimorio image library as a document in Obsidian

summary: Discontinued Obsidian integration that browses a local Grimorio image library, searches annotations and links images to notes.
